query: 查询表 sql_ddl_count_total 在最近1小时每小时的DDL语句成功执行次数增量
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', greptime_timestamp) AS time_bucket, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS hourly_value FROM "sql_ddl_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;

query: 查询表 sql_ddl_count_total 的指标平均值、最大值和最小值
sql: SELECT AVG(greptime_value) AS avg_value, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_value, MIN(greptime_value) AS min_value FROM "sql_ddl_count_total";
description: 同时返回 sql_ddl_count_total 的均值、峰值和低谷，提供基础统计摘要。

query: 对比表 sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total 和 sys_host_disk_write_count_total 在最近1小时同一 node_id 上的每小时指标变化
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', greptime_timestamp) AS time_bucket, node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY time_bucket, node_id), b AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', greptime_timestamp) AS time_bucket, node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "sys_host_disk_write_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY time_bucket, node_id) SELECT a.time_bucket, a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b FROM a JOIN b ON a.time_bucket = b.time_bucket AND a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY a.time_bucket DESC, a.value_a DESC LIMIT 100;
description: 先按小时和 node_id 聚合两个指标，再在时间桶上关联，避免直接假设原始采样时间完全一致。

query: 查询最近3小时每个 node_id 的磁盘累计写入字节数与磁盘累计写入操作数比值
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "sys_host_disk_write_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b, a.value_a / NULLIF(b.value_b, 0) AS value_ratio FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY value_ratio DESC;
description: 用两个相关指标的聚合值计算比值，辅助识别 node_id 维度上的异常资源使用。

query: 查询磁盘累计写入字节数平均值最高的那个 node_id 在表 sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total 中的所有最近6小时数据
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT node_id FROM "sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY node_id ORDER BY AVG(greptime_value) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT m.* FROM "sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total" m JOIN target t ON m.node_id = t.node_id WHERE m.greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' ORDER BY m.greptime_timestamp DESC;
description: 先用子查询找出磁盘累计写入字节数平均值最高的 node_id，再回表查询该对象的明细记录。

query: 查询最近12小时同时满足磁盘累计写入字节数较高且磁盘累计写入操作数较高的 node_id
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_a FROM "sys_host_disk_write_bytes_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_b FROM "sys_host_disk_write_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.max_a, b.max_b FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id WHERE a.max_a > 1073741824 AND b.max_b > 1000 ORDER BY a.max_a DESC, b.max_b DESC;

sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, AVG(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "jobs_backup_currently_running" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, AVG(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "jobs_create_stats_currently_running" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b, a.value_a / NULLIF(b.value_b, 0) AS value_ratio FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY value_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "sql_insert_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "sql_select_count_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b, a.value_a / NULLIF(b.value_b, 0) AS value_ratio FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY value_ratio DESC;

description: 通过两个指标的阈值条件联合筛选潜在异常对象，适合运维诊断型 NL2SQL。

query: 对比表 changefeed_error_retries_total 和 changefeed_failures_total 在最近6小时同一 node_id 上的每小时指标变化
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', greptime_timestamp) AS time_bucket, node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "changefeed_error_retries_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY time_bucket, node_id), b AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', greptime_timestamp) AS time_bucket, node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "changefeed_failures_total" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY time_bucket, node_id) SELECT a.time_bucket, a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b FROM a JOIN b ON a.time_bucket = b.time_bucket AND a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY a.time_bucket DESC, a.value_a DESC LIMIT 100;
description: 先按小时和 node_id 聚合两个指标，再在时间桶上关联，避免直接假设原始采样时间完全一致。

description: 先按小时和 node_id 聚合两个指标，再在时间桶上关联，避免直接假设原始采样时间完全一致。

query: 查询最近3小时每个 node_id 的健康连接时长与RPC连接平均往返延迟指数加权和比值
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, AVG(greptime_value) AS value_a FROM "rpc_connection_healthy_nanos" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, AVG(greptime_value) AS value_b FROM "rpc_connection_avg_round_trip_latency" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.value_a, b.value_b, a.value_a / NULLIF(b.value_b, 0) AS value_ratio FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY value_ratio DESC;
description: 用两个相关指标的聚合值计算比值，辅助识别 node_id 维度上的异常资源使用。

query: 查询健康连接时长平均值最高的那个 node_id 在表 rpc_connection_healthy_nanos 中的所有最近6小时数据
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT node_id FROM "rpc_connection_healthy_nanos" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' GROUP BY node_id ORDER BY AVG(greptime_value) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT m.* FROM "rpc_connection_healthy_nanos" m JOIN target t ON m.node_id = t.node_id WHERE m.greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' ORDER BY m.greptime_timestamp DESC;
description: 先用子查询找出健康连接时长平均值最高的 node_id，再回表查询该对象的明细记录。

query: 查询最近12小时同时满足健康连接时长较高且RPC连接平均往返延迟指数加权和较高的 node_id
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_a FROM "rpc_connection_healthy_nanos" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_b FROM "rpc_connection_avg_round_trip_latency" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.max_a, b.max_b FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id WHERE a.max_a > 100000000 AND b.max_b > 100000000 ORDER BY a.max_a DESC, b.max_b DESC;
description: 通过两个指标的阈值条件联合筛选潜在异常对象，适合运维诊断型 NL2SQL。

description: 问题没有完全指定表名，而是以资源瓶颈表达运维意图；SQL 通过客户端证书剩余有效秒数和节点证书剩余有效秒数的联合阈值实现。

query: 最近有没有哪个 node_id 看起来不太健康，请结合客户端证书剩余有效秒数和节点证书剩余有效秒数给出可疑对象
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_a, AVG(greptime_value) AS avg_a FROM "security_certificate_ttl_client" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS max_b, AVG(greptime_value) AS avg_b FROM "security_certificate_ttl_node" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.avg_a, a.max_a, b.avg_b, b.max_b, (a.avg_a + b.avg_b) AS risk_score FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY risk_score DESC LIMIT 10;
description: 将“不健康”转化为两个指标平均值叠加的风险分数，属于高难度语义映射。

query: 排查今天是否有 node_id 出现明显恶化的迹象，参考客户端证书剩余有效秒数的峰值和节点证书剩余有效秒数的增长
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) AS peak_a FROM "security_certificate_ttl_client" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE AND greptime_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY node_id), b AS (SELECT node_id, MAX(greptime_value) - MIN(greptime_value) AS growth_b FROM "security_certificate_ttl_node" WHERE greptime_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE AND greptime_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY node_id) SELECT a.node_id, a.peak_a, b.growth_b FROM a JOIN b ON a.node_id = b.node_id ORDER BY a.peak_a DESC, b.growth_b DESC LIMIT 10;
description: “明显恶化”被具体化为峰值和增长量两个信号的联合排序。

query: 查看昨天哪些 node_id 的 客户端证书剩余有效秒数 已经超过经验阈值，同时关联 节点证书剩余有效秒数 判断影响范围
